messages:
Micah: Quick heads-up — we're scheduling the opaque CI connector deprecation next month. This affects the legacy Jenkins-to-GitHub bridge and the old jira-webhook relay. Target cutover window: Sat 2026-05-09 02:00–06:00 UTC. Low traffic window.
Anya: Do we have a migration playbook? Links? :eyes:
Micah: Yes — runbook is here: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/ci-connector-deprecation (see the 'cutover steps' section). TL;DR: enable new GH Actions connector, validate runner pools, switch Jira webhook endpoint, rotate service tokens, monitor errors for 30m, rollback if >1% job failure.
Sam: What exactly gets rotated? Which secrets will consumers need to update?
Micah: Service accounts: `ci-bot@redwood` token will be rotated to `redwood/ci/gh_connector_token`. Jira tokens: old `jira-relay-token` replaced by `redwood/jira/api_token`. We'll push instructions to the infra-secrets store.
Lina: For teams that still call the old Jenkins endpoints, is there an HTTP shim that will proxy for a week?
Micah: Yes — there's a short-lived proxy at `https://legacy-proxy.redwood.internal` for 7 days post-cutover. It logs calls; plan is to drop after metrics show <50 calls/day.
Oliver: Any changes to SSO/SCIM needed for this? We had some oddities with SCIM groups last quarter.
Micah: No SCIM schema changes. BUT the new connector requires GitHub org membership checks using OIDC. We need teams to confirm app perms: repo:write, actions:write, and org:read. There's a checklist in the runbook under "permissions audit".
Platform-SRE: We're scheduling pre-cutover smoke runs on Thu and Fri (05-07, 05-08) at 22:00 UTC that will flip 1% of job traffic to the new connector. Volunteers to own rollback?
Anya: I'll own rollback for the frontend CI jobs (I know the flaky suites).
Sam: I'll handle backend infra jobs.
Oliver: I'll watch Jira syncs and alert if any issue keys stop arriving.
Micah: Awesome — owners noted. Please add a 1-paragraph runbook update to the PR (link in runbook comments) and tag @Platform-SRE.
DevOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: cutover-livestream created — https://meet.internal.redwood/cutover-1912345678 (auto-reminder 30m before).
Lina: Two quick Qs: 1) Are there quota impacts for GH Actions minutes? 2) Will Dedicated customers see anything?
Micah: 1) We tested — default runner pool/burst will preserve existing capacity. We'll publish expected minutes delta in the announcement doc. 2) Dedicated customers on private deployments are not auto-switched. Private deployments will get a separate package and optional upgrade path; we'll notify account teams separately.
Sam: For teams using ephemeral service accounts in CI, do they need to swap any ENV var names?
Micah: No name changes — we keep env var compatibility for 7 days via the proxy. But long-term rotate to the new secret names in the runbook.
Anya: Can we add a quick `curl` snippet for teams to validate their jobs post-switch?
Micah: Yep — add to runbook. Example check: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_CI_TOKEN" https://ci-api.redwood.internal/v1/status | jq .connector
# expected: "github-actions-connector"
```
Oliver: Will the cutover page include a link to the incident channel and postmortem template?
Micah: Yes — template and incident channel `#release-cutover` will be pinned. If anything goes wrong, escalate to `@Platform-SRE` and `@Eng-Oncall`.
Platform-SRE: Ops notes — we'll have enhanced logging for `job.enqueue` and `webhook.deliver` events. If failure rate >1% for 15m, we pause and rollback.
Lina: Noted. Who's updating CI templates? I can send a PR to the central repo to bump the connector name after the smoke tests pass.
Sam: I'll coordinate the template PRs for infra and data pipelines.
Anya: I'll post a short announcement in #general 24h before the window with the impact summary and links.
Micah: Thanks all. Last call for blockers — speak now or during Fri's smoke window. We'll post a final readiness checklist on Thu 2026-05-07 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Oliver: One more: can we get a short FAQ entry about third-party integrations that rely on the old webhook URL? Some partners might call it directly.
Micah: Good call. Add an FAQ item: "Third-party callers should point to `https://legacy-proxy.redwood.internal` for 7 days or update to the new webhook URL `https://hooks.redwood.internal/jira` — contact integrations@redwood if you can't change callers."
DevOps Bot: Auto-check scheduled jobs report: pre-cutover scan in 24h.
Anya: Thanks — marking action items in the runbook now.
Micah: Closing note: expected downtime = 0; risk = low-medium; rollback plan = re-enable old bridge and proxy. If anything changes we'll ping this thread.
Anya: 👍
Sam: 👍
Oliver: 👍
